android.desc:
Inkwell is a fast, offline reader for your personal comic and book library. It opens CBR, CBZ, CB7, PDF, and EPUB files straight from your device. No cloud sync, no accounts, no ads, no tracking. Buy it once, own it forever.

Built for people who already have a library on disk and just want a clean way to read it.

WHAT YOU GET

→ Read CBR, CBZ, CB7, PDF, and EPUB files
→ Point Inkwell at any folder on your device and it builds a cover grid automatically
→ Continue Reading row puts your in-progress books one tap away
→ Reading progress saved per book, with a resume prompt when you reopen
→ Paged mode with left-to-right or right-to-left page turns
→ Webtoon mode with continuous vertical scroll for long-strip comics
→ Fit-width or full-page page sizing
→ Optional page-turn animations
→ Orientation lock right inside the reader
→ Organize titles into Shelves with mosaic cover cards
→ Light, Dark, and System themes
→ Grid columns: Auto, 2, 3, or 4
→ Reading statistics: total books, finished, in-progress, pages read
→ Backup and restore your reading progress as a JSON file
→ Built-in crash reporting (logs stay on your device until you choose to send them)

NO NONSENSE

→ No accounts. Nothing to sign up for.
→ No internet permission used at runtime. Your library never leaves your device.
→ No ads. No upsells. No subscription.
→ One-time purchase. Future updates included.

BUILT FOR PERFORMANCE

Inkwell uses libarchive directly through native code to extract pages from CBR and CBZ archives without unpacking the whole file. Pages are cached and prefetched in the background so swiping stays fluid even on large 200MB+ archives.

PDF rendering uses the system PDF engine. EPUB support handles chapter navigation and reflowable content.

PERMISSIONS

Inkwell needs the "All files access" permission so it can read comic and book files stored anywhere on your device, including external SD cards and folders you manage with your own tools. The app does not upload, share, or transmit any of your files. You can verify this yourself: Inkwell does not request the Internet permission.

WHO THIS IS FOR

→ People with their own CBR / CBZ / PDF / EPUB collection
→ Readers who want one app that handles comics, manga, manhwa, webtoons, and ebooks
→ Anyone tired of readers that require accounts, push ads, or sync to a cloud they didn't ask for
→ Privacy-conscious readers who want their library to stay on their device

WHO THIS IS NOT FOR
